notes.title: Tales From The Under-Realm: Lilith is now out!
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that our latest dark fantasy yuri visual novel is out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2896520/Tales_From_The_UnderRealm_Lilith/

It's the final chapter of the Tales From The Under-Realm series, and the game features:
- animated intro movie
- full OST with theme song
- a long story of 140.000 words
- four optional one-night stand scenes
- two love interests (Evelyn and Odette)
- bonus unlockable pin-ups
- over 50 CGs! and 5 different endings

It's the biggest game we've ever done at this price, and if you try it you'll agree. It has optional very spicy adult content, so if you like that be sure to try it!

notes.title: New beta using Ren'Py 8
notes.content:
Hi all,
since some users reported a few issues, I have rebuilt the game using the latest Ren'Py version. It's a major change since it uses Python 3 and modern libraries. Because of that I put the game in beta channel, I've tested it and seems to work but you can never be too sure.

To access it it's enough to do the usual:
- right click on the game name, then "Properties"
- click the "Betas" tab, and then on the drop-down menu, pick "beta - Built with latest Ren'Py".

I plan to keep the old version since users with older system (16-bit) won't be able to use this new beta version once it goes live. Thanks

notes.title: ToA: An Elven Marriage coming to Steam the 16th!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the first Loren spin-off, ToA: An Elven Marriage, will come to Steam the 16th of current month!

To find more info about the game and wishlist it, please visit the page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1629210/Tales_Of_Aravorn_An_Elven_Marriage/

[b]Features[/b]
- four love interests: continue previous romance with Myrth and Rei, or romance Lydia and Nathir
- LGBTQ friendly, offering both straight and homosexual romances, and featuring a non-binary secondary character, Gruff
- 195,000 words of plot (Loren had 230,000 including the DLC)
- branching plot with quest offering different outcomes
- 4 different possible outcomes of the main storyline, with a 5th "secret" happy ending
- the classic turn based, party RPG combat system with front and back row is back
- every legendary weapon and accessory has a unique skill/spell, offering an incredible variety of builds
- simplified potion crafting and item upgrading


this and much more! Stay tuned for a discount on Loren The Amazon Princess next week to celebrate!

notes.title: At Your Feet (my new Kickstarter)
notes.content:
I've just launched my new Kickstarter for a foot fetish yuri dating sim called "At Your Feet": https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/at-your-feet

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/at-your-feet]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2717761/f5030ccfe4444fee3e0aceac8417cde22119383d.jpg[/img][/url]

It's one of the craziest ideas to date, but after so many "serious" games I wanted to do something more silly/funny. Maybe I went a bit too far lol

For those not into feet, the game will of course have more:
- many comedy moments
- usual romance build up. Even if will be a comedy, there'll be some more romantic scenes
- in the optional adult scenes, while the main focus will be on feet, there'll be also other stuff

For those "worried" about us changing into making only yuri games:
- I've put up the Curse Of Mantras game page, a game with ALL romance combos and 10 love interests
https://store.steampowered.com/app/618000/The_Curse_Of_Mantras/
- I'm making good progress with ToA: An Elven Marriage, the next chapter of Elenor/Saren saga which will feature all romance combos again

So more stuff is coming, but those are bigger games and they take a long time to make! Thanks for your patience :)
